Name: MouseMoveMode(Ultimate revision)
Author: ZengGod
Description:
[b][color=#b45f06][font=Comic Sans MS][size=5]本模组支持中文、日语、韩语、英语多种语言[/size][/font][/color][/b]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#b45f06][size=4][b]이 모듈은 중국어, 일본어, 한국어, 영어 등 여러 언어를 지원합니다[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#b45f06][size=4][b]本モジュールは中国語、日本語、韓国語、英語の複数言語に対応しています [/b][/size][/color][/font]
[font=Comic Sans MS][color=#b45f06][size=4][b]This mod supports multiple languages including Chinese, Japanese, Korean and English.
[/b][/size][/color][/font]
[b][i][color=#ff0000][size=6]模组介绍[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[size=4][b]这是一个仿饥荒移动模式的模组，玩家可以用鼠标右键点击或长按移动，支持点击移动、长按跟随、自定义移动按键、强制使用工具按键等，内置一些便捷的辅助功能，如全屏和窗口模式之间切换，缩放屏幕大小等功能[/b][/size]

[b][color=#ff0000][size=6][i]Mod Introduction[/i][/size][/color]
[size=4]This is a mod that imitates the movement style of Don't Starve. Players can move by right-clicking or holding the right mouse button. It supports click-to-move, hold-to-follow, custom movement keys, forced tool-use keys and more. It also comes with convenient built-in auxiliary functions, such as switching between fullscreen and windowed mode, and adjusting screen zoom.[/size][/b]


[color=#ff0000][size=6][b][i]模组功能[/i][/b][/size][/color]

[list]
[*][b][size=4][color=#ff0000]（默认为右键）[/color][color=#d4d4d8]点击或长按右键会让玩家移动，长按移动则在松开后停止[/color][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4][color=#d4d4d8]可在配置菜单里修改为[/color][color=#ff0000]其他按键[/color][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4][color=#d4d4d8]若把按键改成[/color][color=#ff0000]鼠标左键[/color][color=#ffffff]，点击[/color][color=#ff0000]V[/color][color=#ffffff]键强制使用工具[/color][color=#ff0000]（仅在鼠标左键移动下生效）[/color][/size][/b][/*]
[*][b][size=4]强制使用工具[color=#ff0000]默认为V键[/color]，可在模组配置菜单中修改[/size][/b][/*]
[*][size=4][b][color=#d4d4d8]骑行时按住[/color][color=#ff0000]Shift[/color][color=#d4d4d8]键只会鼠标移动[/color][/b][/size][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]按F6键可开/关右键移动模式（游戏开始时自动开启，配置中可更改）[/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]Alt + Enter 可在全屏和窗口模式之间切换[/b][/size][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][size=4][b]CRTL + 鼠标滚轮可以缩放屏幕大小[/b][/size][/color][/*]
[/list][b][i][color=#ff0000][size=5]1.5.1更新[/size][/color][/i][/b]
[list]
[*][b][b][color=#d4d4d8][size=4]新增[/size][/color][color=#85200c][size=4]「移动后与目标交互」[/size][/color][color=#d4d4d8][size=4]开关[/size][/color][color=#5b0f00][size=4]（默认开启）[/size][/color][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][color=#d4d4d8][size=4]开启：到达即交互（自定义键位都生效）[/size][/color][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][color=#d4d4d8][size=4]关闭：只走到目标停下，不执行任何交互[/size][/color][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][size=4][color=#ff0000]注意：[/color][color=#d4d4d8]开启后点击NPC，容易将手上的物品赠送给NPC，[/color][color=#ff0000]请谨慎使用！[/color][/size][/b][/b][/*]
[/list][b][i][color=#ff0000][size=6]Mod Functions[/size][/color][/i]
[/b]
[list]
[*][b][b][color=#ff0000][size=4](Right-click by default)[/size][/color][size=4][color=#d4d4d8] Click or hold right-click to make the player move; movement stops once you release the button when holding it down[/color][/size][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][size=4][color=#d4d4d8]The key can be changed to another one in the config menu[/color][/size][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][size=4][color=#d4d4d8]If the movement key is set to the left mouse button, press the [/color][/size][color=#ff0000][size=4]V[/size][/color][size=4][color=#d4d4d8] key to force-use tools [/color][/size][color=#ff0000][size=4](only works when moving with the left mouse button)[/size][/color][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][size=4][color=#d4d4d8]Force-use tool is set to the [/color][/size][color=#ff0000][size=4]V[/size][/color][size=4][color=#d4d4d8] key by default and can be modified in the mod config menu[/color][/size][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][size=4][color=#d4d4d8]Hold the[/color][/size][color=#ff0000][size=4] Shift [/size][/color][size=4][color=#d4d4d8]key while riding to move only via mouse[/color][/size][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][size=4][color=#d4d4d8]Press F6 to toggle right-click movement mode (automatically enabled when the game starts, adjustable in settings)[/color][/size][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Alt + Enter [/size][/color][size=4][color=#d4d4d8]switches between fullscreen and windowed mode[/color][/size][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Ctrl + Mouse[/size][/color][color=#ff0000][size=4] Wheel[/size][/color][size=4][color=#d4d4d8] zooms the screen in and out[/color][/size][/b][/b][/*]
[/list][b][color=#ff0000][size=5][i]Update 1.5.1[/i][/size][/color][/b]
[list]
[*][b][b][size=4][color=#d4d4d8]Added the toggle [/color][color=#85200c][Interact with Target After Moving][/color] [color=#5b0f00](enabled by default)[/color][/size][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][color=#d4d4d8][size=4]Enabled: Interact upon arrival (all custom keybinds take effect)[/size][/color][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][color=#d4d4d8][size=4]Disabled: Only move to the target and stop, no interaction will be performed[/size][/color][/b][/b][/*]
[*][b][b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Note: [/size][/color][color=#d4d4d8][size=4]When enabled, clicking on an NPC may give the item in hand to the NPC.[/size][/color][/b][/b]
[b][color=#ff0000][size=4]Please use it with caution![/size][/color][/b][/*]
[/list][color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]此模组基于原作者 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ylongkaka]ylongkaka[/url] 制作的 [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2614]Mouse Move Mode[/url] 二次创作[/b][/size][/color]
[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]主页有多语言老版本: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54836]Mouse Move Mode (multilingual)[/url][/b][/size][/color]

[color=#d4d4d8][size=4][b]This mod is based on the original author [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ylongkaka?gameId=1303]ylongkaka[/url] made [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/profile/ylongkaka?gameId=1303]Mouse Move Mode[/url] Secondary creation
There are older multilingual versions of the homepage: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/54836]Mouse Move Mode (multilingual)[/url][/b][/size][/color]

Downloads.Description:
1.5.1
新增「移动后与目标交互」开关（默认开启）
开启：到达即交互（自定义键位都生效）
关闭：只走到目标停下，不执行任何交互
开启后点击NPC，容易将手上的物品赠送给NPC，请谨慎使用！

1.5.0
添加了韩语（한국어）和日语（日本語） 和英文补丁
Korean (한국어), Japanese (日本語) and English patches have been added
